## Key ideas and homework {#fgt3-finish .trig-lesson .log-lesson}

1. Equal distances on a log axis represent equal ratios.
2. A difference in readings gives a multiplier of the underlying quantity.
3. Check the sign, the order of comparison and the units.

::: {.takeaway}
I can connect differences in logarithmic readings to ratios of the underlying quantities.
:::
